features.title: Land Phase-1 span contract: telemetry.schema.json + README.md at .harness/state/telemetry/
features.user_visible_behavior: The kit carries the ratified telemetry span grammar (urn:asdd-harness-kit:schemas:telemetry:1.0) as a committed contract artifact with a README one-pager and a schema-validated conformance exemplar — zero code wiring, no emitters, nothing to gitignore until Phase 2.
verification: exemplar validation: README 4-line mock vs landed schema — required keys, enums, id patterns, closed top level, ≤4KB lines, reserved-attr discipline, trace-model consistency (env-child / synthesized phase own-trace / detection self-trace)
features.evidence: Programmatic validation against the LANDED schema file — all 4 exemplar spans pass schema checks and trace-model checks; schema is valid JSON Schema draft-07.
